items.title: Make the doctor global-core-realpath check linked-worktree-aware
items.context: checkGlobalCoreRealpath (packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:223-245, surfaced via handlers/doctor.ts): the non-self-project branch compares the global @lattice/core realpath against the running CLI's own corePackageRoot without canonicalization, so a worktree-built CLI evaluating a fixture/temp project always warns (expected=.worktrees/B-xxxx/packages/main vs global=canonical main checkout). Fix: canonicalize the non-self expected via the repository containing corePackageRoot (git worktree list anchored at corePackageRoot, mirroring resolveCanonicalSelfCoreRoot lines 755-777); keep the genuine unrelated-path warn. Regression tests: worktree-built-CLI + fixture context passes with no warn and doctor brief returns under the 20000-byte brief-output-smoke budget; a genuinely mismatched global path still warns. Acceptance signal: npm test green from inside a story worktree.
items.userSees: Inside a story worktree, npm test completes green (test:brief-output passes with doctor brief under 20000 bytes); lattice doctor evaluated by a worktree-built CLI on a fixture project shows ✓ global-core-realpath with no Relink or reinstall advice; a genuinely mismatched global path still shows the ⚠ warn

happy.desc: Worktree-built CLI + fixture project: global-core-realpath passes (canonicalized expected = canonical main checkout) and brief-output-smoke doctor budget assertion passes
Real machine: npm run test:brief-output green from inside a story worktree

edge.desc: Self-project context behavior unchanged (expectedSelfCoreRoot path still used); non-git or detached contexts fall back safely without crash

adversarial.desc: Genuine mismatch (global resolving to an unrelated path outside the repo containing corePackageRoot) still warns with the repair hint

verificationEvidence.note: Scenario 1: real git repo + linked worktree fixture; corePackageRoot in the worktree, global symlinked to the canonical main checkout packages/main → globalCoreRealpath.status=pass (canonicalized expected).

Real machine, run from inside story worktree .worktrees/B-fa65 with the worktree-built dist: brief output smoke passed (doctor brief back under the 20000-byte budget; red-evidence failing command flipped green).

Scenario 3: non-git corePackageRoot falls back to un-canonicalized behavior (matching global passes, differing global warns — unchanged). Self-context behavior unchanged: validation-protocol-smoke passes (exercises runRuntimeEnvironmentChecks self/external shapes).

Scenario 2: global symlinked to an unrelated path while core runs from a worktree → status not pass and the resolves-to warning text survives (genuine drift detection intact; different-clone case per decision preMortem 2).
